Sailors Face Danger and Stress in War Zones at Sea

Sailors deployed in war zones are experiencing constant fear of death amidst concerns for their safe return. They face threats from drone and missile attacks, coupled with a lack of shore leave, delays in spare parts, and increasing work stress. In one instance, the Coast Guard rescued a Bangladeshi sailor from a perilous situation at sea.
